effect.name: CMYK (Switch)
effect.description: Shader allows changing cyan, magenta, yellow and black.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's CMYK (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.31 */
parameter.description: Shader allows changing cyan, magenta, yellow and black.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Cyan
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for Cyan colors. (Range from -100 to 100)

parameter.name: Magenta
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for Magenta colors. (Range from -100 to 100)

parameter.name: Yellow
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for Yellow colors. (Range from -100 to 100)

parameter.name: Black
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for Black colors. (Range from -100 to 100)
